description: This file defines the 'DetailedTimesheet' class within the OrangeHRM project. It represents a detailed view of a timesheet, encapsulating a Timesheet object along with associated rows and columns, likely for data transfer purposes in the Time module.

classes.name: DetailedTimesheet
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) representing detailed information about a timesheet, including its rows and columns.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DetailedTimesheet with a Timesheet entity, and arrays of TimesheetRow and TimesheetColumn objects.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Returns the array of TimesheetRow objects.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns the array of TimesheetColumn objects.
